name: Password Sign-In Requires Passkey
summary: The user submits valid password credentials for a durable identity that requires passkey proof; the server accepts the password proof but withholds the authenticated application session and directs the client to the canonical passkey continuation surface.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and an active, fully configured password-enabled durable identity with a registered passkey is ready for sign-in

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Prepared test-user email resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

inputs.name: Password
inputs.description: Valid password generated by the test setup manager and resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

serverInteraction.intent: Accept the submitted password for the identified durable identity, preserve password proof without issuing an authenticated application session, and require continuation through the existing passkey sign-in flow.

postconditions.expression: the durable identity remains active and anonymous to the application while password proof has succeeded and passkey proof is still required

sourceReferences.note: Expected client destination is the existing canonical Passkey Sign In continuation view.
Once the handoff reaches auth.continue.passkey, the existing Passkey Sign In behavior owns the passkey ceremony and authenticated-session completion.
Canonical proposed transition preserves anonymous application state and password proof while requiring passkey continuation.
Password Sign In should support provider=passkey as the passkey analogue of the existing provider=totp MFA handoff.
